note: CPR-40 re-cut the deterministic EVAL-1/2/4/5 merge gate onto public sessions, governed capture candidates, immutable Knowledge, session-scoped query/evaluation lenses and ContextRun (ADR-0099). The six small scenario quality axes and four QA product-scope axes are exact floors because this corpus and ruleset are deterministic. Extraction macro precision/recall retain the measured-minus-0.02 gates from the labelled 50-fixture corpus; ruleset builtin@4 measures 0.983/0.914 by recognising explicit imperative and architectural-choice forms without changing the one-candidate-per-event limit. Per-class extraction scores remain diagnostic. Hallucination, tenant/scope/sensitivity leakage, unattributed context lines and address gaps are zero-count gates. Coverage floors prevent an empty path from passing: the pull-request security slice asks 400 of 11,680 generated variants over 1,276 probes and proves all nine positive controls. The context renderer now emits one JSON data entry per selected immutable revision with normalised source evidence. That evidence-bearing envelope intentionally raises deterministic token cost: tokens_mean measures 260 with a 300 ceiling; tokens_per_answer measures 363.636 with a 420 ceiling. The final deterministic run measures 0.667 bounded lexical retrieval precision against the retained 0.45 floor. Median latency remains the only hardware-variable gate at 250ms; p95 is reported. The deterministic hash embedder is lexical-only, so semantic QA questions are skipped and counted rather than scored. BGE-M3 retrieval, model extraction, the 10,000-variant security run and LongMemEval Stage H have separate baselines and cannot be represented by this result.
